contract: POST /api/session/:id/close. Close an owned/admin open session once, applying optional final sync and persisting only listened sessions; reap transcode and remove stream before one user_session_closed, then reject future sync/close.
exceptions: No separate force/refresh mode is defined for this endpoint; any repeat, changed-input or lifecycle refresh remains unverified in the state scenarios.

invariants.contract: POST /api/session/:id/close with a final sync stores the session with the total listening time, moves the progress, removes the open session, answers the owner's sockets with user_session_closed and the admins with one user_stream_update. Closing a session that never listened, with an empty body, stores no session row and touches no progress, but still removes the session and sends user_session_closed. Closing with an empty body after a sync keeps the synced row as stored and does not touch the progress. A session closes once: a second close or a later sync answers 404 and changes no row, progress or event. An admin can close another user's open session, as the web client's session dialog does; the stored session is kept and user_session_closed goes to the session owner's sockets.
Close is refused with 401 unauthenticated, 404 for an unknown session (before the owner check) and 403 for another non-admin user, and the session stays open without any event.
Closing with a final sync after the item was deleted still answers 200 and closes the session with its event, but stores nothing and moves no progress.
